title: Link the espresso guide to the storefront grind selector
body: Marcus Lee asked for a stable anchor (`#espresso-grind`) in the espresso guide. The storefront grind picker can then link to it as "What grind should I choose?". This is on hold until the $0.00 espresso price bug in storefront-web is fixed.

title: Add a cold brew guide
body: Customers keep asking about cold brew. Add `guides/cold-brew.md` (1:8 concentrate, 16 hours, coarse grind) using the same layout as the other guides. Priya Raman will send a matching illustration.
